activities.title: Construct typed arrays
activities.context: NumPy arrays store typed numerical values. These small authored signal lists are teaching data, not decoded image pixels.

example.source:
import numpy as np

print(values.dtype)

activities.predict: What dtype will the array have?

investigate.question: Why request dtype=float?

activities.title: Understand shape and ndim
activities.context: A two-dimensional array has rows and columns. Shape alone does not tell you whether an axis represents space, time or channels.

example.source:
import numpy as np
image = np.array(grid)
print(image.shape)
print(image.ndim)

activities.predict: Predict the shape tuple and the number of axes.

investigate.question: What does shape (2, 3) mean for this documented row × column grid?
